cards.content_summary: Tier 1: Universal screening and high-quality instruction; Tier 2: Targeted interventions; Tier 3: Intensive individualized interventions

cards.content_summary: Resource constraints, training needs, fidelity of implementation, coordination across tiers

cards.content_summary: Leadership support, professional development, collaborative teams, consistent progress monitoring
